steps.name: Collect damage evidence
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for photos showing the damage to the item and packaging, and confirm which item(s) arrived damaged.

steps.name: Look up order
steps.instruction: Retrieve the order to confirm the item, brand, category, line total, and days since order.

steps.name: Review photos
steps.instruction: Review the submitted photos to confirm the reported damage such as crushed crate, chipped edge, leaking finish, or broken bottle.

steps.name: Check guarantee and return eligibility
steps.instruction: Determine whether the item is covered by a lifetime guarantee, and whether any non-returnable restriction applies (power tool brand, final sale, or software/plans/clearance).

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: If the damage is confirmed and the item is not barred by a non-returnable or final-sale restriction, approve replacement. Otherwise deny the request. Shipping charges are waived for damaged items.

steps.name: Issue replacement
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue a replacement for the damaged item and notify the customer of the ETA.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.condition: Item is clearance or final sale

steps.name: Verify order and proof of purchase
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm valid proof of purchase exists. Without proof of purchase the return cannot be accepted.

steps.name: Gather item condition and category
steps.instruction: Ask the customer whether the item is unopened and unused, and confirm item category, brand, and whether it is a power tool.

steps.name: Check return eligibility by item type
steps.instruction: Deny return if the item is downloadable plans or software, clearance or final sale, or a Laguna or Sawstop power tool. Return window is 90 days from purchase.

steps.name: Check power tool and condition requirements
steps.instruction: For power tools, the item must be unused and in original packaging, and authorization is required on all returns.

steps.name: Decide ruling and rewards adjustment
steps.instruction: Issue the ruling. If the original order used promotional Rewards Cards, void unused cards or reduce the refund by the amount redeemed at Rockler's discretion.

steps.name: Act on approved return
steps.instruction: If approved, send the return label and issue the refund, partial refund, or store credit per the ruling. If denied, communicate the policy reason to the customer.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.condition: Laguna or Sawstop power tool

outcomes.remedy: Decline the return as outside the return window
outcomes.condition: Over 90 days from purchase

steps.name: Collect failure details
steps.instruction: Ask the customer which item failed (router bit or drawer slide), the failure symptom (seized bearing, snapped carbide tip, worn cutting performance, or similar), and approximate years of use.

steps.name: Verify order and item
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm the item brand, category, and lifetime guarantee status. No proof of purchase is required for the guarantee.

steps.name: Check guarantee eligibility
steps.instruction: Confirm the item is a Rockler router bit or a Rockler TopSlide/Centerline Lifetime drawer slide and that the claim is a failure to perform. If so, the guarantee covers replacement regardless of proof of purchase.

steps.name: Check return exclusions
steps.instruction: Confirm whether the item is a Laguna or Sawstop power tool or a clearance (final sale) item. These clauses govern returns, so the claim should be handled as a guarantee replacement, not a return. Refer Laguna or Sawstop power tool claims to staff, since no guarantee clause covers them.

steps.name: Decide replacement ruling
steps.instruction: If the item is an eligible Rockler router bit or lifetime drawer slide that failed in use, rule to approve a replacement. Otherwise, route the case to staff.

steps.name: Acknowledge customer
steps.instruction: Send the customer a reply acknowledging the guarantee claim and confirming the replacement decision.

steps.name: Issue replacement
steps.instruction: After authorization, issue a replacement for the failed Rockler router bit or drawer slide and provide the shipping timeline.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

outcomes.remedy: Issue a replacement under the lifetime guarantee
outcomes.condition: Item is a Rockler router bit or Rockler TopSlide/Centerline Lifetime drawer slide that failed to perform, with or without proof of purchase

outcomes.remedy: Non-returnable per policy; no listed guarantee clause covers this item, so staff review the claim
outcomes.condition: Item is a Laguna or Sawstop power tool claimed under the lifetime guarantee

outcomes.remedy: Final sale items are not eligible for return; the guarantee only applies if the item is an eligible Rockler router bit or lifetime drawer slide
outcomes.condition: Item is a clearance (final sale) item

steps.name: Verify order and backorder status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has shipped or been picked up, and which items are on backorder.

steps.name: Collect item details
steps.instruction: Confirm the brand and final-sale status of each item in the order so cancellation and return eligibility can be evaluated.

steps.name: Check cancellation eligibility
steps.instruction: If the order has not been picked up, the cancellation is permitted under the cancellation-before-pickup policy.

steps.name: Check return fallback for failed cancellation
steps.instruction: If the order has already been picked up, evaluate whether the items are returnable; exclude Laguna and Sawstop power tools and clearance final-sale items.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: Approve cancellation with refund when eligible; otherwise deny the cancellation and any refund, citing the governing clause.

steps.name: Cancel order and issue refund
steps.instruction: After authorization, cancel the order and issue the refund for the cancelled items.

steps.name: Close-out (placeholder)
steps.instruction: After the customer is resolved: disposition of the item (restock / open-box / return to vendor / carrier claim) for retail; recovery within policy for airlines. Designed, not implemented, in the POC.

steps.name: Verify order shipment status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has shipped.

steps.name: Gather item details
steps.instruction: Collect the brand, power tool status, and final sale status of the item(s) in the order.

steps.name: Check cancellation eligibility
steps.instruction: If the order has not been picked up, it can be cancelled. If it has shipped, cancellation is too late and the return policy applies instead.

steps.name: Check return eligibility of shipped items
steps.instruction: For shipped orders, check whether the items are non-returnable because they are Laguna or Sawstop power tools or clearance final sale items.

steps.name: Decide ruling
steps.instruction: Deny the cancellation when the order has shipped. Redirect the customer to returns if the items are returnable; otherwise deny the return as well.

steps.name: Communicate ruling
steps.instruction: Draft the reply explaining the denial and the available return or store credit path.

steps.name: Verify order and backorder status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm the inquired item is on backorder (order.is_backordered) and identify the item brand, power tool status and final-sale status.

steps.name: Check backorder policy
steps.instruction: Confirm the out-of-stock item is held on back order and the rest of the order is placed; this governs whether a cancellation or status update is appropriate.

steps.name: Provide ETA or status update
steps.instruction: Tell the customer the backorder status and the best available ship estimate from merchant data; do not promise a firm date unless verified.

steps.name: Handle cancellation requests
steps.instruction: If the customer asks to cancel or return the backordered item, apply return eligibility: Laguna and Sawstop power tools and clearance final-sale items are non-returnable; otherwise a cancellation of the backordered item may be authorized.

steps.name: Apply authorized update
steps.instruction: If a cancellation or order update is approved under the decision, execute it with authorization.

steps.name: verify_order_shipped
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has already shipped and which items and quantities are on it.

steps.name: check_item_attributes
steps.instruction: For each item on the order, retrieve brand, power tool status and final sale status to determine which return policy applies if the customer pushes back.

steps.name: decide_quantity_change_denied
steps.instruction: If the order has shipped, deny the requested quantity increase because shipped orders cannot be modified. Do not add items to a shipped order.

steps.name: offer_new_order_alternative
steps.instruction: Tell the customer the extra quantity must be placed as a new order, and explain that any return of the shipped items follows the returns policy, noting non-returnable Laguna or Sawstop power tools and final sale clearance items.

steps.name: Verify order and shipment status
steps.instruction: Look up the order and confirm whether it has already shipped and the current shipping address on record.

steps.name: Collect requested address change
steps.instruction: Ask the customer for the corrected or new shipping address and the reason for the change.

steps.name: Check item eligibility for return if cancellation failed
steps.instruction: If the order has already shipped and the customer wants to redirect or return items, evaluate the items against returns policy by brand, power tool status, and final-sale status.

steps.name: Decide address change ruling
steps.instruction: Deny the address change when the order has shipped. Where the order has not shipped but is past the cancellation window, offer a return under policy only if items are eligible; otherwise deny.

steps.name: Issue remedy if eligible
steps.instruction: If the ruling grants a store credit or refund under policy, execute it after authorization; otherwise take no monetary action.

steps.name: Escalate exceptions to supervisor
steps.instruction: Escalate to a supervisor when the ruling is contested or falls outside the listed policy.
